fee_details:
- Joining Fee: Rs. 8,999+GST
- Renewal Fee: Rs. 4,999 + GST (Note: Annual fee will be waived off on retail spends of above Rs.2,00,000 (last annually)
- Rate of interest on overdue amount: 2.99% monthly and 35.88% annually
joining_perks: Earn 40,000 Yes Rewards points as welcome bonus
reward_structure:
- Earn 50 Yes Reward points on every Rs. 2,000 spent on online shopping
- Earn 30 Yes Reward points on every Rs. 2,000 spent on offline shopping
- Earn 10 Yes Reward points on every Rs. 2,000 spent across categories like groceries, utility bills, roadside assistance etc.
- Yes Reward Points = Miles: 1 Club Vistara Point
key_highlights:
- Get Purchase Protection Plan up to Rs.50,000 and Credit Shield cover of Rs.15 lakh (Loss, Liablity & Card Loss protection of Rs.15 lakhs).
- Enjoy complimentary domestic airport lounge visits in India per calendar quarter for primary and Add on cardholders
- Get unlimited complimentary international access for primary as well as add on card holders
- On international transactions, get a mark-up fee of 1% only

reward_point_benefits: - Yes Reward Points will not be earned on fuel transactions, installment or post purchase EMIs, cash withdrawals or cash advances fees and charges.

fees_and_charges.Renewal Fee: Rs. 4,999 + GST (Note: Annual fee will be waived off on retail spends of above Rs.2,00,000 (last annually)
fees_and_charges.Rental Transactions: Minimum 1% of the transaction value or Rs. 50 whichever is higher (capped at 3 transactions per 30 days)
fees_and_charges.Wallet Transactions: Minimum 2% of the transaction value or Rs. 50 whichever is higher
fees_and_charges.Education for Payments: 1% fee on GST on transactions through platforms like ICICI, PhonePe, No Broker etc., capped at Rs.1000 per calendar month. This is applicable from October 2024
fees_and_charges.Utility Charges: 1% fee on GST on utility spends above Rs. 15,000 per month, capped at Rs.2000 per month.

miscellaneous: Cardholders can earn points on their everyday purchases, which can be redeemed for a wider range of rewards including travel, dining, shopping and more. Additionally, the Marque card provides exclusive access to concierge services to select partner merchants. It is a valuable tool for those who enjoy indulging in a luxury experience. Whether it’s access to exclusive events, coverage discounts, or complimentary movie tickets, this credit card offers many benefits that enhance users’ overall lifestyle.

faqs.Does Yes Marque credit card support cont: Yes, you can make contactless payments using Yes Marque credit card.
faqs.Can YES Reward points be converted to ai: Yes, You can convert YES Reward Points into air miles. The conversion is: 4 YES Reward Points = 1 Club Vistara Point or 1 InterMiles.
faqs.Can a 18-year-old apply for a Marque cre: The minimum age of the applicant should be 21 years.
faqs.What are the minimum salary criteria to: The applicant should have a minimum salary of Rs. 3 Lakh p.a or should be a HNI (Rs. 70 Lakh or above annually).
